title: One-click deploy
key_points: One-click deploy is a feature that allows users to automatically export, install and run projects on connected devices.
It requires a properly configured platform and supported device.
The feature is available for Android, iOS, desktop platforms, and Web.
Configuring one-click deploy varies by platform.
Troubleshooting steps are provided for each supported platform.
limitations: Requires a runnable export preset to function.
Only one runnable preset per platform can be marked as runnable.
The feature doesn't work on platforms without the required settings configured correctly.
asserts: One-click deploy allows users to automatically export, install and run projects on connected devices by configuring their development environment properly.
not: The documentation does not claim that one-click deploy is universally compatible with all possible user configurations or hardware setups.
